title: Answer: no account of which systems are conscious, beyond a testable prediction about scale

statements.text: Causal emergence takes no position on which systems are conscious. Its paper with integrated information theory reads that question through that theory: the physical substrate of consciousness is a set of elements at the spatiotemporal grain where intrinsic cause and effect power is maximally irreducible. The paper proposes testing in humans whether the brain's maximum of cause and effect power matches the scale of experience, and, if it does, extrapolating to the scale of experience in other species.
statements.scope: Can the macro beat the micro? Integrated information across spatiotemporal scales (2016)
